say:1:1422519001:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，你这么快就回来啦！

say:2:1422519002:1.text: I want to give this to you before I go... Look, isn't this what you've always wanted?
say:2:1422519002:1.source_cn: 我想把这个交给你再离开……看，这是你一直想要的东西吗？

say:3:1422519003:1.text: A palace that fits in my hands? It's so beautiful...
say:3:1422519003:1.source_cn: 这是一座可以放在手上的宫殿？好美丽……

say:4:1422519004:1.text: It's called the Tenebris Court, the most exquisite building in the royal city. Your Queen resides there.
say:4:1422519004:1.source_cn: 它叫永夜圣庭，是艾塞勒王城最美丽的建筑，你们的女王就居...

say:5:1422519005:1.text: Balkar, thank you... I've always wondered what the royal city looks like. You really know me well!
say:5:1422519005:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，谢谢你……我一直想知道它的样子，好厉害，你是怎...

choice_prompt:6:1422519005.text: Balkar, thank you... I've always wondered what the royal city looks like. You really know me well!
choice_prompt:6:1422519005.source_cn: 巴尔克，谢谢你……我一直想知道它的样子，好厉害，你是怎么知道我的愿望的！

say:7:1422519006:1.text: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...
say:7:1422519006:1.source_cn: 其实我只是想知道外面的世界长什么样子，想知道平民区外面...
say:7:1422519006:1.male: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...
say:7:1422519006:1.female: Actually, I'm just curious about the world beyond the commoners' district...

say:8:1422519007:1.text: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!
say:8:1422519007:1.source_cn: 平民区的小孩子都知道，大部分平民一辈子都要待在平民区，...
say:8:1422519007:1.male: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!
say:8:1422519007:1.female: We all know we'll probably spend our entire lives here, but still, I really wish to see the scenery outside!

say:9:1422519008:1.text: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!
say:9:1422519008:1.source_cn: 不仅有王城，还有巴尔克说的他的家乡！
say:9:1422519008:1.male: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!
say:9:1422519008:1.female: I wish to visit the royal city, as well as Balkar's hometown!

say:10:1422519009:1.text: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...
say:10:1422519009:1.source_cn: 他们都说地表很可怕，但巴尔克却说地表是另一个美丽的世界……
say:10:1422519009:1.male: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...
say:10:1422519009:1.female: They all say the surface is a horrible place, but Balkar tells me otherwise...

say:11:1422519010:1.text: Balkar, thanks for showing me what I could only imagine before! I'm so happy!
say:11:1422519010:1.source_cn: 巴尔克，你又一次帮我看到了想象中的风景！我现在好开心！

say:12:1422519011:1.text: I'm glad you like it! Now, I can finally leave with my heart at ease.
say:12:1422519011:1.source_cn: 你开心就好！现在我终于能放心地回去了。

say:13:1422519012:1.text: I'll bring you some cool stuff from the surface when I get back!
say:13:1422519012:1.source_cn: 等我回来，我给你带地表好玩的东西！

say:14:1422519013:1.text: I can't wait! Go ahead, Balkar! Don't worry about me!
say:14:1422519013:1.source_cn: 我一定会喜欢的！巴尔克放心回家吧，别再担心我啦！

choice:6:0:1.text: Do you wish to move there?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 西蒙的愿望是在王城生活吗？
choice:6:0:1.male: Do you wish to move there?
choice:6:0:1.female: Do you wish to move there?
